<thought>The observed isotopic pattern shows a dominant monoisotopic peak with decreasing intensities at +1, +2, +3 Da, matching the natural 13C distribution for a molecule containing many carbons. No other element’s characteristic isotopic pattern (e.g., Cl, Br, S) is evident, so only carbon can be definitively identified.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
